info.name: DummyJSON API Quality Suite

item.name: Negative
item.description: Invalid, missing, and malformed authentication scenarios.

item.name: AUTH-004 Login rejects invalid password

request.description: Characterization based on OBS-2026-07-31-001. Uses a request-local invalid password and does not modify valid runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: invalid password returns observed status 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('Characterization: invalid credentials response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { errorBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics indicate invalid credentials', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/invalid.*credentials/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });

pm.test('Characterization: error semantics identify required credentials', function () { pm.expect(errorBody.message).to.be.a('string').and.match(/username/i).and.match(/password/i).and.match(/required/i); pm.expect(errorBody).not.to.have.any.keys('accessToken', 'refreshToken'); });

item.name: 02 - Products CRUD
item.description: Documented product reads and explicitly simulated, non-persistent write operations.

item.name: Read
item.description: Product list, dynamic fixture discovery, and single-product retrieval.

item.name: PROD-001 List products and store an existing product ID

request.description: Retrieves a bounded documented page and stores the first returned positive ID for existing-resource tests. It makes no assertion about the mutable global catalog total or product ordering.

exec: pm.test('Product list succeeds with status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Product list response is valid JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { listBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Product list contains a bounded non-empty products array', function () { pm.expect(listBody.products).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(listBody.products.length).to.be.above(0).and.at.most(requestedLimit); });

pm.test('Product list pagination metadata matches the request without fixing total', function () { pm.expect(listBody.total).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(listBody.skip).to.eql(0); pm.expect(listBody.limit).to.eql(requestedLimit); });
pm.test('Every returned product has a positive numeric ID', function () { listBody.products.forEach(function (product) { pm.expect(product.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); }); });

pm.test('Validated first product ID is stored for existing-resource tests', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(listBody.products).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(listBody.products.length).to.be.at.most(requestedLimit); pm.expect(listBody.total).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(listBody.skip).to.eql(0); pm.expect(listBody.limit).to.eql(requestedLimit); listBody.products.forEach(function (product) { pm.expect(product.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('existingProductId', String(listBody.products[0].id)); });

item.name: PROD-002 Get existing product by ID

request.description: Retrieves the runtime-discovered existing product and validates identity and field types without hardcoding mutable product content.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('existingProductId')) { throw new Error('PROD-001 must provide existingProductId before PROD-002'); }

pm.test('Existing product request succeeds with status 200 and JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { productBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });
pm.test('Returned product ID matches the runtime-discovered ID', function () { pm.expect(productBody.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('existingProductId'))); });

pm.test('Present core product fields have appropriate types', function () { const expectedTypes = { title: 'string', category: 'string', description: 'string', price: 'number' }; Object.keys(expectedTypes).forEach(function (field) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(productBody, field)) { pm.expect(productBody[field], field).to.be.a(expectedTypes[field]); } }); });

pm.test('Simulated creation returns a new positive ID', function () { pm.expect(createBody.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); });

pm.test('Simulated creation reflects every submitted value', function () { pm.expect(createBody.title).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('testProductTitle')); pm.expect(createBody.price).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('testProductPrice'))); pm.expect(createBody.description).to.eql(pm.variables.get('testProductDescription')); pm.expect(createBody.category).to.eql(pm.variables.get('testProductCategory')); });

pm.test('Creation assertion is limited to the documented non-persistent simulation', function () { pm.expect(createBody.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); pm.expect(pm.request.url.toString()).to.include('/products/add'); });

item.name: 03 - Search Filtering and Pagination
item.description: Product discovery and relational query behavior without fixed catalog totals or mutable fixtures.

item.name: Search
item.description: Search response contracts and separately baselined matching characterization.

item.name: QUERY-001 Search returns relevant products

request.description: Validates the documented search envelope. Matching fields are a narrow characterization from OBS-2026-07-31-015; the test requires at least one reasonable field match somewhere, not a match in every field or result.

exec: pm.test('Search request succeeds with status 200 and JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { searchBody = pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Search response has a coherent non-empty product envelope', function () { pm.expect(searchBody.products).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(searchBody.total).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(searchBody.products.length); pm.expect(searchBody.skip).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(searchBody.limit).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(searchBody.products.length); });

pm.test('Characterization: at least one reasonable searchable field corresponds to the query', function () { const query=String(pm.collectionVariables.get('searchQuery')).toLowerCase(); pm.expect(query).not.to.be.empty; const hasMatch=searchBody.products.some(function (product) { const values=[product.title,product.description,product.category,product.brand].concat(Array.isArray(product.tags)?product.tags:[]); return values.some(function (value) { return typeof value==='string' && value.toLowerCase().includes(query); }); }); pm.expect(hasMatch).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Search does not rely on an exact mutable result count', function () { pm.expect(searchBody.products.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(searchBody.total).to.be.at.least(searchBody.products.length); });

item.name: QUERY-002 Search returns an empty result for a unique query

request.description: Observed characterization from OBS-2026-07-31-016 using a fresh unlikely query each run. The documentation does not guarantee no-result metadata.

exec: pm.test('Characterization: unique no-result search returns observed status 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Characterization: no-result search response is JSON', function () { pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { emptySearchBody=pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('Characterization: unique search returns an empty zero-result envelope', function () { pm.expect(emptySearchBody.products).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; pm.expect(emptySearchBody.total).to.eql(0); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(emptySearchBody,'skip')) pm.expect(emptySearchBody.skip).to.eql(0); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(emptySearchBody,'limit')) pm.expect(emptySearchBody.limit).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Pagination
item.description: Pagination, page comparison, field selection, and limit-zero behavior.

item.name: QUERY-006 Retrieve first page and store product IDs

request.description: Retrieves the first configured page, validates relational metadata and unique positive IDs, then stores those IDs as JSON for QUERY-007.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.unset('pageOneIds'); const limit=Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('pageLimit')); if (!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<=0) { throw new Error('pageLimit must be a positive integer'); }

pm.test('First page succeeds with status 200 and JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect((pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase()).to.include('application/json'); pm.expect(function () { pageOneBody=pm.response.json(); }).not.to.throw(); });

pm.test('First-page product IDs are positive and unique', function () { const ids=pageOneBody.products.map(function (p) { pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); return p.id; }); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length); });
